blocks.text: Pakistan ka jughrafiya shimal ki sab se oonchi chotiyon se junoob mein Arabian Sea tak phaila hai, jo ecological tanawwu ki 'chhoti si duniya' banata hai. Yahan is ke chaar sab se ahem ecosystems bayan kiye gaye hain: temperate deciduous jangal, tropical thorn jangal, alpine aur sub-alpine charagahein aur mangrove jangal.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein Pakistan ke bayan kiye gaye chaar ecosystems batayein.
blocks.explanation: Temperate deciduous jangal, tropical thorn jangal, alpine aur sub-alpine charagahein, aur mangrove jangal.

items: Pakistan: Himalaya ki chotiyon se Arabian Sea tak; chaar ahem ecosystems.
